description: Convert an uploaded file to another format, with no AI. Word, Markdown, text, HTML and .odt → docx, pdf, md, txt, html, odt, rtf; Excel and CSV → xlsx, csv, pdf, md, txt; PowerPoint → pptx, pdf, md, txt; PDF → docx, md, txt; PNG and JPEG → pdf, md. Scanned PDFs and pictures are read with OCR. md, txt, html and csv come back as `text` (use md to read any file); the rest as a download link valid 5 minutes. The first 1000 conversions each month are free, then 0.01 € each.

file_id.description: From upload_file, or the id of a document Doconda made (list_documents).
